name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
objectiveText: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles. Unhatched Sprite Darter Egg (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: If you go do this quest, you might wanna bring 2 Elixirs of Fortitude right away. Quentin will ask for those for the next part.
At level 49, this got me 1050 XP and a slight increase in Darnassus reputation.
You need to complete the quest Freedom for All Creatures (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=2969) to start this quest.
replies: Just an addittion, when you do the Freedom for All Creatures quest, it leads to Doling Justice quest chain, Once that is completed you need to return to feralas and speak with kindal once more to get this quest started  Also I would recommend getting the flight paths to theramore frm gadgetzan, then from menethil to Airie Peak for the timed portion later on prior to starting this

comments.body: You need to finish "Doling Justice" before you can do this.
The night elf in question is in Feralas, not Azshara.
